narrative.intro: Uchicago Argonne reported $81.1M in federal contract obligations for FY2027 to date. Uchicago Argonne obligations in earlier fiscal years were substantially larger: FY22 totaled $1.1B, FY23 totaled $1.1B, FY24 totaled $1.2B, FY25 totaled $1.3B, and FY26 totaled $1.2B. Current-year totals are partial, fiscal year to date, so the FY2027 number represents activity so far in the year rather than a full fiscal year total. Uchicago Argonne shows a sharp pullback in obligations this fiscal year relative to the multi-year trend of roughly $1.1B to $1.3B per year seen from FY22 through FY26. Contract volume for FY2027 to date is concentrated into a single award, which explains the identical total and average award figures reported for the period.
